methodology: total/by_year = decisions in the served corpus by decision year. portal_total = the source portal's own result count where the daily scrape can observe one (not every portal exposes totals). gap = portal_total - our_count at check time; a gap is NOT necessarily missing data — see the per-court note. Publication practice varies enormously between courts: absence of a decision here usually means the court never published it.

courts.note: The portal was never down: from Feb 2026 the scraper sent the court filter STRK where the portal expects StRK (case-sensitive), and every query answered zero rows. Fixed 2026-11-08; the portal lists 367 decisions (2015-2026).

Direct scrape at parity since the docket-anchored parser fix of 2026-08-27: on 2026-09-15 the portal's 11,633 listing rows resolved to 11,600 distinct dockets, all held (11,618 held in total). The remaining listing difference is duplicate or under-filled rows of the date-windowed listing.
Official collection complete (verified 0 missing vs external benchmark). Volume citations before 1954 partially carry publication-year dating semantics.

Complete for published decisions from 2000 (verified against citation-gap oracles). Pre-2000 ordinary judgments were never put online by the court. Pre-2007 EVG social-insurance decisions (~15,215) are recoverable and queued.

The Kantonsgericht published ~4,997 decisions on a portal that went offline; 903 recovered via the Internet Archive (2026-04). Outreach to the court pending since 2026-04-17; remainder is a known upstream-availability gap, not a scrape failure.

Verified complete 2026-09-15: every case year 2013-2026 was enumerated and 7,691 of 7,695 listed decisions were held (the other 4 were published that day), including the bulk publication of 11.12.2018 for case years 2014-2017 (2,552 decisions, all held). The portal returns at most 500 rows per query, so the nightly log warns for case years above 500; nothing is missing.

Frozen archive from amtsdruckschriften.bar.admin.ch, two distinct parts. (1) The VPB/JAAC series: 2,502 PDFs, 1987-2017 (publication ended 1 Jan 2018), cited as VPB <number>. Vols. 51-70 (1987-2006) hold every number but 70.32, 2007-2017 every number but 2014.3. (2) About 20,400 Bundesblatt, Amtliches Bulletin and Amtliche Sammlung pages from the same entscheidsuche CH_VB feed, removed in 2026-10 and restored on 2026-10-31: not rulings, dates unreliable, all tagged language=de though many are French or Italian, cited as "Bundesverwaltung <docket>".
Registered source; the authority has published zero decisions to date (0 by design, not a failure).

7,051 decisions (ATAS/ACJC 2006-2013) had unreadable CID-font PDF text; recovered via OCR on 2026-07-01 and fully searchable since 2026-07-02. Docket field carries bare cause numbers for some older rows.
Complete archival corpus of the Militärkassationsgericht, volumes 1-16 (1915-2025); the court publishes no new volumes.

The portal is online but frozen: it lists the same 2,205 decisions every night, newest upload 2022-12-19. A successor portal appeared in 2026 and is re-probed weekly; intake resumes if it yields decisions.
Publication practice example: St. Gallen published 5 of 272 employment rulings 2002-2017. Low counts here reflect court publication policy, not capture failure.

~549 rows carry no machine-readable date (PDFs truncated upstream). Text completeness restored 2026-06-29 (control-character stripping). Since 2026-09-15 new rows take their decision date from the result table; older undated rows await a backfill.
Frozen entscheidsuche-sourced archive of the pre-2015 FindInfo portal; new VD decisions arrive via the direct vd_gerichte scraper.

The portal counts documents: ZWR/RVJ journal reprints and same-day re-uploads share a case number with the decision, which the corpus holds once; since 2026-09-15 the gap metric counts distinct case numbers. About 4-5 second rulings filed under an already-held case number (district court and Kantonsgericht) are not in the corpus yet (identity decision pending).
